title: Direct and Indirect Wildland Fire Exposures and Impacts in California's Wildland-Urban Interface
Does Regulation Distort Exit Decisions? Evidence from U.S. Power Plants
venue: Energy Institute at Haas Working Paper
abstract: Hundreds of power plants have closed in the United States since 2010, including 130+ gigawatts of coal and 50+ gigawatts of natural gas. In this paper, we highlight the potential for regulation to distort this type of exit decision. Using generator-level data from 2010–2023, we show that regulated units have been 45% less likely to exit than unregulated units. For unregulated units, exit decisions are made based on wholesale electricity prices, ongoing capital costs, and other traditional economic factors. In contrast, owners of regulated units are largely insulated from these factors and, in some cases, have a strong incentive to continue operating capital-intensive equipment. Previous work documents how this regulatory distortion affects investment decisions. Our paper emphasizes that these same incentives affect exit decisions as well. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 自2010年以来，美国已有数百座发电厂关闭，其中包括超过130吉瓦的煤电和超过50吉瓦的天然气发电。本文强调，监管可能扭曲此类退出决策。利用2010–2023年的机组层面数据，我们发现受监管机组退出的可能性比不受监管机组低45%。对于不受监管的机组，退出决策基于批发电价、持续资本成本及其他传统经济因素。相比之下，受监管机组的所有者在很大程度上不受这些因素影响，并且在某些情况下，有强烈动机继续运营资本密集型设备。已有研究记录了这种监管扭曲如何影响投资决策。本文强调，这些相同的激励同样影响退出决策。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Intermittency or Uncertainty? Impacts of Renewable Energy in Electricity Markets

title: Recent Findings and Methodologies in Economics Research in Environmental Justice
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This review synthesizes economics-oriented research in environmental justice with a focus on the last decade. We first categorize this literature into broad areas of inquiry and review main findings. Then, we review recent advances in data and methodologies that have allowed for new study designs and research questions. After identifying breakthroughs, we offer some guidance on how to continue to advance research in this area.
abstract_zh: 本综述以过去十年为重点，对以经济学为导向的环境正义研究进行了梳理。我们首先将这一文献归入若干大的研究领域，并回顾其主要发现。随后，我们回顾了数据和方法方面的最新进展，这些进展使新的研究设计与研究问题成为可能。在确认这些突破之后，我们就如何继续推进该领域研究提出了一些指导性意见。

title: Can Bitcoin Mining Increase Renewable Electricity Capacity?
abstract: Proponents of Bitcoin argue that demand for electricity from Bitcoin miners can lead to an increase in renewable electricity capacity. We rigorously evaluate this claim by estimating a Bitcoin electricity demand curve and include this demand curve in a long-run model of the Texas electricity market. We find that while Bitcoin mining can indeed increase renewable capacity, it also increases carbon emissions. When Bitcoin miners provide grid management services in the form of demand response, their emissions impact is largely mitigated.
abstract_zh: 比特币支持者认为，比特币矿工对电力的需求可以带动可再生电力装机容量的增长。我们通过估计比特币电力需求曲线，并将该需求曲线纳入德克萨斯州电力市场的长期模型，严格检验了这一主张。我们发现，尽管比特币挖矿确实可以增加可再生能源装机容量，但它同时也会增加碳排放。当比特币矿工以需求响应的形式提供电网管理服务时，其排放影响在很大程度上得以缓解。

title: Decomposing Trends in U.S. Air Pollution Disparities from Electricity
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper quantifies and decomposes recent trends in U.S. PM2.5 disparities from the electricity sector using a high-resolution pollution transport model. Between 2000-2018, PM2.5 concentrations from electricity fell by 89% for the average individual, more than double the decline rate in overall U.S. ambient PM2.5 concentrations. Across racial/ethnic groups, we detect a dramatic convergence: since 2000, the Black-White PM2.5 disparity from electricity has narrowed by 95% and the Hispanic-White PM2.5 disparity has narrowed by 93%, though these disparities still exist in 2018. A decomposition reveals nearly all of these disparity trends can be attributed roughly equally to improvements in emissions intensities and compositional changes in electric generators, with small contributions from scale and residential location changes. This suggests both local air pollution policies and recent coal-to-natural gas fuel switching have played major roles in reducing U.S. racial/ethnic pollution disparities from electricity. While we detect similarly large PM2.5 improvements for the average low and high income individual, PM2.5 disparities by income are relatively small, with little change over time.
abstract_zh: 本文利用高分辨率的污染传输模型，量化并分解了电力行业所导致的美国PM2.5差异的近期变化趋势。2000年至2018年间，电力行业产生的PM2.5浓度使普通个体的暴露下降了89%，是美国环境PM2.5总体浓度下降速度的两倍以上。在不同种族与族裔群体之间，我们发现了显著的趋同：自2000年以来，电力行业所致的黑人与白人之间的PM2.5差异缩小了95%，西班牙裔与白人之间的差异缩小了93%，尽管到2018年这些差异仍然存在。分解结果显示，几乎所有这些差异变化趋势，大致同等地归因于排放强度的改善和发电机组构成的变化，而规模变化和居住地点变化的贡献较小。这表明，地方空气污染政策以及近期从煤炭向天然气的燃料转换，都在减少美国电力行业所致的种族与族裔污染差异方面发挥了重要作用。虽然我们发现，低收入与高收入个体的PM2.5同样大幅改善，但按收入划分的PM2.5差异相对较小，且随时间变化不大。

title: Equitable Low-Carbon Transition Pathways for California's Oil Extraction
U.S. West Coast Droughts and Heat Waves Exacerbate Pollution Inequality and Can Undermine Emission Control Policies
abstract: Droughts reduce hydropower production and heatwaves increase electricity demand, forcing power system operators to rely more on fossil fuel power plants. However, less is known about how droughts and heat waves impact the county level distribution of health damages from power plant emissions. Using California as a case study, we simulate emissions from power plants under a 500-year synthetic weather ensemble. We find that human health damages are highest in hot, dry years. Counties with a majority of people of color and counties with high pollution burden (which are somewhat overlapping) are disproportionately impacted by increased emissions from power plants during droughts and heat waves. Taxing power plant operations based on each plant’s contribution to health damages significantly reduces average exposure. However, emissions taxes do not reduce air pollution damages on the worst polluting days, because supply scarcity (caused by severe heat waves) forces system operators to use every power plant available to avoid causing a blackout.
abstract_zh: 干旱会减少水电产量，热浪会增加电力需求，迫使电力系统运营商更多地依赖化石燃料发电厂。然而，对于干旱和热浪如何影响发电厂排放所造成的健康损害在县级层面的分布，人们了解得较少。我们以加利福尼亚州为案例，在500年的合成气象集合下模拟了发电厂的排放。我们发现，人类健康损害在炎热干燥的年份最为严重。以有色人种为多数的县，以及污染负担较高的县（二者在一定程度上有所重叠），在干旱和热浪期间，受发电厂排放增加的影响尤为严重。根据每座发电厂对健康损害的贡献来对其运营征税，可显著降低平均暴露水平。然而，排放税并不能减少污染最严重日子的空气污染损害，因为供应短缺（由严重热浪导致）迫使系统运营商动用每一座可用的发电厂，以避免停电。

title: Well Setbacks Limit California's Oil Supply with Larger Health Benefits and Employment Losses than Excise and Carbon Taxes
Long-term Trends in Wildfire Damages in California
abstract: In 2017 and 2018, wildfires in California burned millions of hectares and caused billions of dollars in structure damages. This paper puts these recent fires in a long-term historical context by assembling four decades of data on wildfires in California. We combine administrative data of structure loss due to wildfire with economic data on replacement costs and spatial data on fire locations and sizes. We find that over the period 1979–2018, wildfires in California have been getting larger and that the trend is accelerating. This same trend is seen in the wildland–urban interface. As well, total structure damage from wildfires has grown steadily during the past four decades. Our conclusion is that the recent California fires are not an anomaly, but rather part of a trend towards larger and increasingly destructive wildfires.
abstract_zh: 2017年和2018年，加利福尼亚州的野火烧毁了数百万公顷土地，并造成数十亿美元的建筑物损失。本文通过汇集加利福尼亚州长达四十年的野火数据，将这些近期的火灾置于长期历史背景之中。我们将因野火造成的建筑物损失行政数据，与重置成本的经济数据以及火点位置和面积的空间数据相结合。我们发现，在1979年至2018年期间，加利福尼亚州的野火规模日益扩大，且这一趋势正在加速。在野地与城市交界地带也可以看到同样的趋势。同样，在过去四十年中，野火造成的建筑物总损失稳步增长。我们的结论是，近期的加利福尼亚州火灾并非异常现象，而是野火规模越来越大、破坏力越来越强这一趋势的一部分。
